# doccraft

> A React + Vite + TypeScript documentation site framework. Clone the template, configure three files, and ship a fully-featured docs site for any project.

## Quick start

```bash
npx create-doccraft my-project-docs
cd my-project-docs
npm run dev
```

## Three files to configure

- `src/site.config.ts` — site title, logo, GitHub URL, version badge, accent colour, edit URL
- `src/nav.ts` — sidebar navigation structure (NavItem[] array)
- `src/App.tsx` — import pages and register React Router routes

### site.config.ts fields

```typescript
export const siteConfig = {
  title: 'My Project Docs',   // header + browser tab
  logo: '🚀',                 // emoji shown in logo box
  logoUrl: '',                // optional image URL — replaces emoji box (place file in public/)
  github: '',                 // optional — shows GitHub button in header
  version: '',                // optional — shows version badge in header
  accentColor: '',            // optional hex — overrides default blue accent everywhere
  editUrl: '',                // optional — base URL for "Edit this page" links
                              // e.g. 'https://github.com/user/repo/edit/main/src'
                              // then use: <DocLayout editPath="pages/docs/MyPage.tsx">
}
```

Everything inside `src/framework/` is the engine — do not modify it.

## Writing a page

```tsx
import { DocLayout, Callout, CodeBlock } from '../framework'

export default function MyPage() {
  return (
    <DocLayout>
      <h1>Page Title</h1>
      <p>Body text here.</p>
      <Callout type="tip" title="Tip">Use h2 and h3 headings — they appear in the right TOC.</Callout>
    </DocLayout>
  )
}
```

After writing the page:
1. Add it to `src/nav.ts` under the appropriate section
2. Import and register a `<Route>` in `src/App.tsx`

## Available components

All imported from `'../framework'` (or `'../../framework'` for pages in subdirectories).

### DocLayout
Wraps every page. Provides progress bar, right-side TOC, and prev/next navigation.
```tsx
<DocLayout>
  {/* page content */}
</DocLayout>
```

### Callout
Highlighted notice block.
- Props: `type` ("note" | "tip" | "warning" | "danger" | "info" | "quote"), `title` (optional string)
```tsx
<Callout type="warning" title="Watch out">Content here.</Callout>
```

### CodeBlock
Syntax-highlighted code block with one-click copy. Uses highlight.js.
- Props: `language` (ts | tsx | js | jsx | python | bash | json | yaml | css | html), `children` (string)
```tsx
<CodeBlock language="typescript">
  {`const x: number = 42`}
</CodeBlock>
```

### DocTable
Styled data table.
- Props: `headers` (string[]), `rows` (string[][])
```tsx
<DocTable
  headers={['Name', 'Type', 'Description']}
  rows={[['title', 'string', 'The page title']]}
/>
```

### Badge
Inline status or language badge.
- Props: `type` ("python" | "ts" | "js" | "electron" | "active" | "archived"), `label` (optional string override)
```tsx
<Badge type="active" label="stable" />
<Badge type="python" />
<Badge type="archived" label="deprecated" />
```

### Diagram
Mermaid diagram rendered inline.
- Props: `children` (Mermaid chart string)
```tsx
<Diagram>{`
flowchart TD
  A[Start] --> B{Decision}
  B -- Yes --> C[Done]
`}</Diagram>
```

### Tabs / Tab
Tabbed content panels with accessible role attributes.
```tsx
import { Tabs, Tab } from '../framework'

<Tabs>
  <Tab label="npm">
    <CodeBlock language="bash">npm install my-pkg</CodeBlock>
  </Tab>
  <Tab label="yarn">
    <CodeBlock language="bash">yarn add my-pkg</CodeBlock>
  </Tab>
</Tabs>
```

### CodeBlock (filename prop)
Optional `filename` prop shows the file name in the header:
```tsx
<CodeBlock language="typescript" filename="src/site.config.ts">
  {`export const siteConfig = { title: 'My Docs' }`}
</CodeBlock>
```

### Search
Live search across all pages defined in nav.ts. Triggered by ⌘K / Ctrl+K.
Built into the header automatically — no configuration needed.

## Navigation structure (nav.ts)

```typescript
export const NAV: NavItem[] = [
  { label: 'Home', path: '/' },
  {
    label: 'Getting Started',
    children: [
      { label: 'Introduction', path: '/docs/introduction' },
      { label: 'Installation',  path: '/docs/installation' },
    ],
  },
]
```

## Features

- Light (warm white) and dark (earthy neutral) theme with localStorage persistence
- Collapsible sidebar with toggle button — state persisted in localStorage
- Breadcrumbs above page content derived from nav.ts structure
- "Edit this page" link — set `editUrl` in site.config.ts, pass `editPath` to DocLayout
- Right-side on-page TOC tracking h2 and h3 headings
- Reading progress bar
- Prev / Next page navigation based on nav.ts order
- Live search with keyboard navigation (⌘K, arrows, Enter, Escape)
- Mermaid diagrams (flowchart, sequence, state, etc.)
- Syntax-highlighted code blocks (highlight.js, github-dark theme) with optional filename tab
- Tabbed content panels (`<Tabs>` / `<Tab label="...">`)
- Back to top button

## Project structure

```
src/
  framework/          ← doccraft engine (do not edit)
    components/
      DocLayout.tsx
      Sidebar.tsx
      Search.tsx
      TableOfContents.tsx
      ui/
        Badge.tsx
        Callout.tsx
        CodeBlock.tsx
        Diagram.tsx
        DocTable.tsx
    styles/globals.css
    index.ts          ← barrel export
    ThemeContext.tsx
  site.config.ts      ← configure: title, logo, github, version
  nav.ts              ← configure: sidebar navigation
  App.tsx             ← configure: route registration
  pages/              ← your content pages
  main.tsx
```

## Deploying

```bash
npm run build   # outputs dist/
```

Deploy `dist/` to any static host: Vercel, Netlify, GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages.

For GitHub Pages with a custom subdirectory, set `base` in `vite.config.ts`:
```ts
base: '/your-repo-name/'
```
